paragraphs.text: The proposer offers a two-section 15 kV arc-resistant metal-clad switchgear lineup, compliant with the specifications outlined in the RFP. This lineup includes eighteen 15 kV vacuum circuit breaker positions equipped with protective relays and controls, two revenue meter positions, two sets of 15 kV isolation switches, bus voltage transformers (VTs), and multi-ratio current transformers (CTs). Additionally, future bays are designed to be fully functional, excluding the vacuum circuit breakers, as specified in the contract documents.

The proposed switchgear lineup adheres to the NEMA SG 4 standard for alternating-current high voltage circuit breakers. The vacuum circuit breakers included in the lineup have been tested and rated in accordance with this standard, ensuring compliance with the RFP requirements.

The proposer will supply and install a battery charger for the auxiliary power system, connecting it to panel LP-1 as specified in the RFP. This includes providing the necessary conduit from panel LP-1 to the battery charger for power connection.
